verdict.rationale: Mobile access is a fair question for a planning and tracking tool, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a native mobile app, mobile access to Projects, or feature parity with desktop. The docs cover only web views (table, board, roadmap), custom fields, workflows, the API, an official CLI and an MCP server, none of which is a mobile app.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality
